rows.resolution_note: p001 sentence 4 gives the accession ebi-a-GCST006414, which no dictionary row lists by prefix, range or identifier (rule C4). Its counts (60,620 cases, 970,216 controls) equal those of 'Atrial fibrillation (Nielsen 2018)', but the source is an abstract with no reference entry, so the in-text 'Nielsen et al. (2018)' is not a citation verified by DOI, PMID or PMC identifier and rule C5 does not apply; an unlisted accession with matching counts and no such citation stays absent (rules G, C5). Step 2's exact N with year was weighed and set aside because rules G and C5 address this configuration and govern where they differ.
rows.quote: Summary statistics for AF were drawn from Nielsen et al. (2018) AF GWAS (OpenGWAS ID: ebi-a-GCST006414; 60,620 cases, 970,216 controls; n=1,030,836).
